messages:
Alex: kicking off Brightline APAC on-prem bring-up. high level checklist below — need signoff on GPU counts, networking MTU, and customer firewall windows. planning window: next Tue-Thu (maintenance).

Alex: key items:
- confirm GPU SKU: customer requested 8 x A100-sxm4 initially, possible bump to 16 x H100 if perf tests go poorly
- air-gapped image delivery: rsync + signed tarball (sha256) to jumpbox, images loaded from local repo
- control plane reachability: 443 (control plane), 6443 (k8s api), 2379-2380 (etcd), 50051 (gRPC edge), 10250 (kubelet)
- BGP peering / route targets: customer will peer with our eBGP ASN 64512, advertise /23 for tenant overlay
- MTU: set 9000 on host NICs and overlay (confirm with customer switches)
- KMS/HSM: customer wants HSM-backed keywrap for model keys; need PKCS#11 test vectors and certificate exchange
- NTP and time drift check: align to customer PPS source or fallback to pool.ntp.org

Alex: Ops tasks for tomorrow: snapshot current images, generate signed manifest, run pre-seed smoke tests on local dev rack, and push the image bundle to the airgap bundle server.

Julia: on GPUs — are we committed to A100s or can we offer mixed pool? Brightline said cost-sensitive, might accept mixed A100/H100 for tiering.

Alex: prefer uniform for perf predictability, but we can deploy 8 A100 + 4 H100 as "burst" pool behind routing policy. will need capacity gating in runtime to avoid mixing in a single request.

Mike: routing policy is easy — tag nodes with pool=burst and runtime will steer non-latency-critical workloads there. but need to update autoscaler thresholds and docs.

OpsBot: [bootstrap-bundle] created bundle 202404-194777-1 by Alex — checksum: sha256:3f7a9e2b... (artifact located on s3://redwood-airgap/brightline/202404-194777) :package:

Sara: cost note — committed reserved price for A100s in APAC region is ~25% lower than on-demand; if customer takes 12-month reserved it drops more. we'll surface tradeoff to sales.

Kevin: monitoring checklist: node-exporter, nv_peer_mem, dcgm-exporter, nvidia-smi collector. add persistent logs to customer S3 and enable per-pod token-level traces for first 48h. also set up alert: GPU ECC errors > 1/hr -> page on-call.

Nate: please verify image hashes before install. run: 
```
sha256sum redwood-runtime-bundle.tar.gz
# compare to manifest value
```
Also include a small script to validate rpm repo metadata after rsync.

Julia: network Q — customer firewall requires explicit outbound allowlist; do we need to request open egress for model telemetry? they said no external telemetry. so we need to disable any outbound telemetry or route it through customer-proxy.

Alex: yes — telemetry disabled by default in Private installs; if they want retained logs we recommend S3 via their VPC endpoint. we'll prepare a minimal offline telemetry package if they ask.

Mike: can we enable fallback to Hosted for bursts if on-prem capacity is saturated? customer explicitly asked to avoid cross-tenant data flow. so fallback must be gated and only for non-sensitive workloads. need legal sign-off.

Sara: sales/legal note: fallback to Hosted requires E2E consent in SOW. add clause to SOW about "burst fallback and data residency constraints".

Kevin: ops runbook items to validate during handoff:
- confirm BGP session established and routes propagated to k8s nodes
- validate MTU by running iperf or ping -s with df fragments
- run a short perf test: load 4k tokens seq len 1024 inference across a sample model, measure p50/p99
- verify KMS wrapping/unwrapping using test key id 'brightline-test-01'

Nate: adding image verification step to runbook: `curl -s https://internal-manifest.local/brightline/202404-194777/manifest.json | jq -r .bundles[0].sha256` then compare. will add to playbook.

Alex: OK — tagging action owners: Julia (GPU mix + SOW change), Nate (image checksum + rsync validation), Kevin (monitoring + alerts), Mike (runtime routing policy + autoscaler config), Sara (pricing + legal clause), Alex (bundle + bootstrap ops).

Alex: final ask — please reply with :thumbsup: when you've completed your pre-checks; aim to start physical delivery window Tue 03:00 - 08:00 UTC.

Julia: :thumbsup:
Mike: :thumbsup:
Nate: added the jq check to playbook, :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll push dashboards and alerts by EOD, :thumbsup:
Sara: looping in sales/legal, noted.

OpsBot: [handoff] deployed runbook to confluence: /ops/brightline/apac/onprem-bootstrap (ID BRG-APAC-0424)

Alex: thanks everyone — will run a final preflight tomorrow 09:00 UTC and post go/no-go.
